1.

Jesus, Thou my shelter And my heart’s delight, At Thy faithful breast I have eternal comfort.

2.

All that burdens my soul Upon Thee I cast, Who upon the way here Bearest all my burden.

3.

Toil, want, and tears, All that wounds the heart, Sin and sorrow and anguish Here in the valley of death.

4.

Shall not separate me, For such is Thy will, Lord, from Thee, Because Thou lovest me.

5.

That Thou mightest eternally win me Thou didst let Thy blood flow, Didst die for me, Lamb of God, Upon the tree of the cross.

6.

Eternal life Thou givest, Thine I am and remain; Nothing shall separate me, Lord, now from Thee.
